red_team.case_for_morning: The morning dossier already expected a five-group joint text, so confirming it adds little. Naming Babiš may cost some EPP national delegations while the bill is not yet law; ECR and PfE stayed off the text. Two comparables straddle the line (385, 347), so a figure near 0.55 is honest; the outsider's fall from 0.74 to 0.52 shows how thin the evidence is.
red_team.case_for_larger: Attendance decided the comparables (537 voting gave 347, 585 gave 385), and a noon voting time shared with the 2027 budget usually draws 620-680 voters. At ~88% turnout of the five groups' ~495 members the tally lands near 390-400; a few ODS/ECR votes could add. The anchor's Normal model gives 0.65 and more for budget-day turnout.
red_team.verdict: The fact moves the outcome (p_if_held), barely the timing. The case for a larger move is somewhat stronger, but rests partly on the budget-slot turnout the morning anchor already weighed; 0.60 is defensible and conservative. Nothing sent back.
